Create a precise game asset ATLAS in a STRICT 4 COLUMN by 3 ROW rectangular GRID of 12 equal cells, fill whole image edge to edge, no outer margins, no gutters, subtle straight grid separators exactly at 25%,50%,75% width and 1/3,2/3 height. Every cell has plain warm parchment background. Landscape canvas. Opaque detailed hand-painted gouache illustration for a 1930s Chinese pawnshop game, muted warm colors, realistic object construction, no photographs, no UI buttons, NO explanatory text, NO labels, no numerals marking cells. All same object identity. Each cell must be separately usable. Row1: cell1 whole undamaged object, cell2 same whole object with minor exterior damage, cell3 same whole object with major exterior damage, cell4 an illustrated authentic reference plate split visually LEFT/RIGHT into the two tier2 detail subjects. Row2: cells1/2/3 respectively original/repaired/imitation tier2 evidence plates, each plate has LEFT subject1 and RIGHT subject2; cell4 an ambiguous worn low-visibility plate of the same tier2 subjects, impossible to establish identity. Row3: cells1/2/3 respectively original/repaired/imitation tier3 magnified evidence plates, each LEFT subject1 and RIGHT subject2; cell4 authentic tier3 reference LEFT/RIGHT subjects. Exterior damage must ONLY be in row1 columns2/3. Never show interior evidence in whole-object row1 views. Preserve spatial subject positions across variants; LEFT detail centered at quarter cell width, RIGHT detail at three quarters cell width. Make repair and imitation evidence visibly different exactly as described.
